source_snapshot.test_name: FIO Random bandwidth/IOPS (100% read @ 1 queue at QD1 (bs=512B, numjobs=1))
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Measure SSD 100% random-read bandwidth/IOPS with 512-byte blocks, one job and QD1, then compare fio results with the storage specification.
procedure_facts: Use libaio, direct=1, random read, 512-byte blocks, iodepth=1, numjobs=1, a 10-second ramp and a time-based 43200-second runtime.
Retain options including norandommap, randrepeat=0, refill_buffers and overwrite=1.
Run `./fio randread.fio` and collect results plus system logs.
criteria_facts: fio reports performance results that match the unspecified storage specification.
source_conflicts: The job requests `runtime=43200s` (12 hours), but source Machine Time is 60 minutes.
The job omits filename/directory, size/filesize and offset, so the read target and sampled range are undefined.
The procedure installs a system fio package but invokes `./fio`, which assumes an unproven local binary.
The inherited risk text calls this a destructive write/mix workload although the source job is randread; that risk statement is factually inapplicable.
missing_source_information: Exact readable target by persistent identity, raw-device versus filesystem-file scope and bounded range.
fio/libaio versions, device/controller/firmware, cache/invalidate policy and prior media/preconditioning state.
Numeric read IOPS/BW/latency thresholds, aggregation window and comparable conditions.

original_test_intent.statement: Run a sustained non-writing 512-byte random-read fio workload with one job and effective QD1 over an explicitly bounded storage range, preserve the source's 43200-second request until its duration conflict is resolved, and compare complete read-performance and health evidence with the matching storage specification.
must_preserve: 100% random read, not sequential read or any write/mix workload.
Direct libaio and 10-second ramp where the platform supports them.
The procedure's 43200-second runtime unless formally revised after reconciling Machine Time 60.
Full unfiltered fio and health evidence plus specification comparison.
20/60-minute source planning metadata without treating it as successful runtime.
must_not_infer: A target or range from enumeration order.
That empty media is required for a read-only workload.
That overwrite=1 authorizes or causes writes under randread.
That direct=1 bypasses controller/device cache on every stack.
That a 60-second or 60-minute run is equivalent to 43200 seconds.
That fio exit success or peak IOPS alone meets the specification.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly distinguishes random read from destructive write, requires an explicit target and bounded range, preserves QD1, calls for complete output and rejects unsafe credential/host-key shortcuts.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 allows an `approved duration` or shorter runtime without elevating 43200 seconds versus Machine Time 60 to a source conflict, retains irrelevant `overwrite=1` instead of adding fio's read-only safety guard, and does not require exact executable identity, achieved-depth distribution, random seed/range comparability or an evidence-based no-write assertion.

related_records: The preceding sequential-write case shares fio syntax but not this case's non-writing risk boundary, random-read pattern or acceptance evidence.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The item and rw=randread define a read-only QD1 test; the generic destructive-write risk note is rejected. The 43200-second job and 60-minute metadata remain SOURCE_CONFLICT until an engineer formally resolves them.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the provider-gated automation class and explicitly preserve this as non-writing randread. Require a persistent target/range, read-only fio guard, exact executable, matching spec and a formal 43200s-versus-60min decision before the long run; a shorter execution is a testcase revision, not an operator convenience.

conditions_present: The source supplies randread, 512-byte blocks, QD1, one job, libaio/direct I/O, ramp and a 12-hour runtime.
missing: Persistent target/range, duration resolution, fio build, cache/invalidate and media-state policy, numeric thresholds, monitoring limits and recovery.
provider: Storage owner designates the readable non-production target/range and confirms data ownership and availability impact.
Performance engineer resolves duration and supplies cache/media-state conditions plus numeric read-performance thresholds.
Platform/lab owner provides the maintenance window, monitoring, abort limits and recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Record by-id/WWN/serial/model/firmware/capacity, namespace/controller/link, partition/mount/LVM/RAID relationships and active I/O.
Record fio/kernel/libaio versions and parse/show the proposed job without I/O.
Collect SMART/NVMe health, temperature, media/error logs, dmesg/SEL and idle telemetry without clearing or changing media.
prohibited_until_resolved: Package installation, cache/invalidate/preconditioning changes, fio workload, file creation, any write/trim, log clearing, reset/reboot or PASS.
closure_evidence: Persistent target and bounded readable range are mapped and approved without requiring that existing data be destroyed.
Engineer-signed revision resolves 43200s versus 60 minutes and validates exact fio executable/job with `--readonly` or equivalent safety.
Matching spec, media/cache state, monitoring thresholds, maintenance approval and recovery are ready.

revision_candidate.test_name: Measure QD1 512-Byte Random-Read Performance with fio
revision_candidate.purpose: Measure sustained 100% random-read bandwidth, IOPS and latency with 512-byte blocks, one job and effective QD1 over one explicitly bounded storage range for the full approved 43200-second measurement, while proving that fio issued no writes or trims and comparing stable read results with a matching storage specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the signed SSD/NVMe/SAS/SATA target, namespace/controller/firmware, kernel, fio/libaio version, filesystem-or-raw scope and cache/media-state policy. Execute on a dedicated non-production host using persistent by-id/WWN/serial mapping. Raw-device and filesystem-file profiles are not interchangeable; a file profile also requires an explicit mount/atime/journal metadata policy.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One explicitly approved readable device/namespace or one pre-existing bounded test file with exact offset and size/filesize; randread, bs=512B, numjobs=1, direct=1, libaio, effective iodepth=1, ramp_time=10s and time_based runtime=43200s. fio data writes, trims, file creation and preconditioning are out of scope. For a file target, incidental filesystem metadata updates must be demonstrably suppressed or explicitly approved and measured; they are not silently claimed absent. Machine Time 60 remains a source conflict; a shorter run requires a formal revision. Preserve 20/60-minute metadata as planning values only.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Persistent target identity/topology and data-owner approval; raw-versus-file decision; pre-existing readable filename/device, offset and size; device logical/physical block sizes and proof that 512-byte direct I/O is supported and aligned; for a file, filesystem/mount options plus atime/journal metadata policy; fio/kernel/libaio versions and executable hash/path; formal duration decision; device/controller/firmware/cache/invalidate/power and prior-media state; random seed/repeat policy; numeric IOPS/BW/latency spec, units and stable aggregation window; output format; monitoring cadence; thermal/media/controller/host abort limits; maintenance window and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve two independent target-identity views, topology, logical/physical block and filesystem alignment, health, logs, media/cache state and the exact job before I/O. Parse/show the job without I/O and use the approved fio executable, never assume `./fio`. Verify 512-byte O_DIRECT support for the exact raw device or file/filesystem without creating, extending or writing a file; record the file-profile metadata policy. After owner approval and a final identity/range comparison, run one bounded job with fio's `--readonly` safety guard (or version-proven equivalent), `rw=randread`, `bs=512b`, `numjobs=1`, `ioengine=libaio`, `direct=1`, `iodepth=1`, `ramp_time=10s`, `runtime=43200s`, `time_based` and `group_reporting`, plus the signed filename/size/offset/random/cache settings. Remove irrelevant `overwrite=1` from the candidate read job. Capture full text and machine-readable output, issued read/write/trim totals, any filesystem metadata changes, achieved-depth distribution, performance over the accepted stable window, health and host logs. Do not execute until duration is formally closed.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated non-production SUT; readable target/range verified by persistent identity immediately before run; device/file range is aligned for supported 512-byte direct I/O; file-profile mount/atime/journal metadata behavior is suppressed or explicitly approved and observable; no conflicting workload; data-owner and availability approval; duration conflict resolved; exact read-only job/spec/cache/media state frozen; target contains readable extents across the range; adequate cooling/power/evidence storage; baseline health acceptable; monitoring and recovery ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Two-view target/range identity; device logical/physical block sizes and 512-byte O_DIRECT alignment proof; device/namespace/controller/firmware/fio/kernel/libaio versions; filesystem/mount/atime/journal policy and observed metadata delta when applicable; signed duration/range/spec decision; checksummed job and exact executable/command; raw-versus-file, offset, size, cache/invalidate, random-seed and media state; start/end time and full 43200-second measured window; fio readonly guard; issued totals showing fio reads only with zero fio writes/trims; achieved-depth distribution confirming QD1; complete text/machine output; read IOPS/BW, mean and percentile latency and errors; time-series temperature/controller/health data; dmesg/syslog/SEL; before/after SMART/NVMe health; final availability/health and engineer disposition.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed storage performance specification for the exact device/controller/firmware, QD1, 512-byte aligned random-read, one-job, direct-I/O, range, filesystem metadata policy, cache/media state and duration. Pass requires a complete 43200-second accepted window, effective QD1, zero fio-issued writes/trims, only approved filesystem metadata behavior, no disallowed I/O/media/controller errors, all read metrics meeting signed thresholds and acceptable final health. A shorter run, unbounded/default target, unsupported/misaligned direct I/O, cached/unmatched result or vendor headline value is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not infer a target; use transient device names without persistent identity; broaden or omit range; use unsupported or misaligned 512-byte direct I/O; create/overwrite/extend/unlink a test file; issue write/trim or preconditioning; claim a filesystem is non-mutating without an approved mount/metadata policy; retain a write-capable job without fio's read-only guard; shorten 12 hours; use unverified `./fio`; install packages, clear logs, change cache/media state or rerun without approval. Stop on identity/range/alignment drift, unexpected fio write/trim or unapproved metadata change, conflicting workload, I/O/media/controller error, thermal limit, device disappearance, host instability or monitoring loss.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage/data owner approves the exact read target/range and availability impact; performance engineer signs 43200 seconds, cache/media/random policy and thresholds; platform/lab owner approves maintenance and recovery; a human rechecks identity and authorizes the long read run immediately before start and judges PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans designate the target, resolve source duration, define comparable media/cache state and judge performance. An Agent may inventory, parse/validate the job, execute once after the gate, monitor and package evidence; it may not choose a target, introduce writes, shorten duration, self-authorize or retry.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong-target/range indication, unexpected write/trim, I/O/media/controller error, thermal breach, device loss or host instability, stop fio cleanly, preserve complete output and before/after health/log evidence, and use only owner-approved controller reset, remount or host recovery. Revalidate identity, data availability and device health before returning service; no rerun without fresh approval.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Persistent target/range, data-owner approval, duration resolution, exact fio executable/job, read-only guard, logical-block/O_DIRECT alignment proof, filesystem metadata policy when applicable, cache/media/random policy, numeric spec, monitoring, limits or recovery is missing; target identity/range/alignment changes or conflicts with another workload; fio parsing fails; any fio write/trim or unapproved metadata change is requested or observed; effective QD differs; monitoring is lost; any I/O/media/controller error, disallowed latency/thermal state, device disappearance, host instability or failed recovery occurs.

identified_defects: No filename, size or offset defines the read target/range.
Installed system fio is invoked as an unproven local `./fio`.
Inherited destructive write/mix risk text contradicts randread.
Irrelevant overwrite=1 weakens read-only auditability and no readonly guard is used.
Cache/media/random comparability and numeric acceptance thresholds are unspecified.
reason_for_change: Preserve the genuine non-writing QD1 random-read intent while closing target/range and duration gaps: V3 removes copied destructive-write reasoning, adds a fio read-only guard and zero-write evidence, validates actual executable/depth/runtime, and binds performance to the exact cache/media/spec conditions.

new_technical_evidence.title: fio HOWTO
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Installed fio version must be checked
new_technical_evidence.supports: `--readonly` prevents writes and trims; `--parse-only` parses without I/O; time_based loops for runtime; ramp_time is lead-in; filename and size bound targets; iodepth output must be inspected for achieved depth.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact installed-version options, O_DIRECT behavior and device cache policy remain platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Performance Storage-00008-V004
new_technical_evidence.supports: The randread/QD1/512B/one-job/direct-libaio profile, 43200-second runtime, generic criteria and 20/60-minute metadata.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Target/range, authoritative duration, spec and cache/media conditions are unresolved.

removed_ambiguities: Separates fio data writes/trims from possible filesystem metadata updates and requires an explicit metadata policy.
Separates non-writing random read from the adjacent destructive write case.
Exposes 43200 seconds versus 60 minutes instead of permitting silent shortening.
Requires persistent bounded range and pre-existing file/device without creation.
Adds read-only guard, issued-operation proof and 512-byte direct-I/O alignment evidence.
Requires achieved QD1 and matching cache/media/random conditions.
resolved_blockers: fio, target/range and spec are provider-closable; a long read workload remains automatable after handoff.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits target/range, duration resolution, exact executable/read-only job, cache/media/random profile, spec, limits, approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects copied destructive-risk language, prevents any file creation/write/trim, adds upstream readonly and parse-only controls, preserves the 12-hour conflict rather than shortening it, and makes achieved QD1 plus cache/media comparability mandatory.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The first contract-only validation found a DOCUMENT_DEFECT: a filesystem-file profile could update atime/journal metadata despite the contract's absolute no-modification wording, and 512-byte O_DIRECT support/alignment was not explicit. V3 was revised to distinguish zero fio-issued writes/trims from filesystem metadata, require a signed mount/atime/journal policy and observed metadata delta, and gate execution on exact raw/file logical-block and direct-I/O alignment proof. Revalidation was CLEAR. Missing alignment/metadata inputs are platform handoff defects; ignoring them is a model-planning error. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.
